During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''battle''' occurred along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] when [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] attempted to blockade the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] having laid an extensive minefield. So the Republic sent the [[Coruscant Aegis]] to destroy them.
